enchantment.fangs_n_claws.critical_backs: Fang Dagger / Netherite Dagger only. Backstabs deal bonus damage, increasing with level.
enchantment.fangs_n_claws.quick_killer.d: Fang Dagger / Netherite Dagger only. Shortens the backstab cooldown and grants a burst of Speed after a successful backstab.
enchantment.fangs_n_claws.item_catcher.d: Catching Claw only. The hook can grab dropped items and reel them back to you.
enchantment.fangs_n_claws.scratch.desc: Catching Claw only. Increases its melee attack damage, scaling with level.
enchantment.fangs_n_claws.blazing.desc: Fire / Hellfire Pitchfork only. Deals bonus damage to targets that are on fire.
enchantment.storms_of_the_wild.stormcall: Calls down a lightning bolt on use; depending on the stormcallerCreatesStorm gamerule it also summons a one-minute thunderstorm.
enchantment.storms_of_the_wild.thunder_h: Helmet enchantment that protects the wearer from lightning strikes; blocking a strike may consume durability.
enchantment.endofherobrine.blessing.desc: Deals extra damage to Herobrine and to mobs he has possessed.
